stories.title: US weighs new Iran strikes as Vance reaches out on talks
stories.summary: In the eighth month of the US-Iran war, the two sides have sent mixed signals over escalation or a deal. The Wall Street Journal reported that CENTCOM chief Adm. Brad Cooper briefed President Trump on options for renewed attacks, while the New York Times reported US-Israeli plans to strike after the November 3 midterms. In parallel, the Washington Post reported that Vice President JD Vance offered to meet Iran's Mohsen Rezaei, and Iran's parliament speaker said progress depends on seven conditions, including lifting sanctions and the US naval blockade. The outcome bears on Gulf security and global energy markets.

stories.title: G20 foreign ministers meet in Atlanta amid Iran war, Ukraine and trade divisions
stories.summary: G20 foreign ministers began a two-day meeting in Atlanta hosted by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, the last ministerial under Washington's G20 presidency. South Africa was not invited, Russia's Sergey Lavrov is attending, and Ukraine was not invited. French sources said no joint declaration is expected, with the US possibly issuing chair's conclusions instead. Leaders are due to meet in Miami on December 14 and 15.

stories.title: Nasdaq drops sharply as Amazon and Intel earnings fuel tech sell-off
stories.summary: US stocks fell in morning trading on Friday, with the Nasdaq down about 2.6%, the S&P 500 about 1.5% and the Dow about 0.7%, according to Yahoo Finance's live coverage. Amazon shares fell about 4% after an earnings miss, and Intel shares dropped sharply after its fourth-quarter outlook fell short, which the company attributed to sluggish PC sales. Amazon and Alphabet results renewed investor concern about Big Tech's heavy AI spending. Figures are intraday and changed during the session.

stories.title: Ukraine renews drone attacks, hitting Russian oil refinery in Samara region
stories.summary: An oil refinery in Russia's Samara region was struck in renewed Ukrainian drone attacks, according to Al Jazeera. Russian authorities said they intercepted more than 1,000 Ukrainian drones over multiple regions overnight. The report gives no casualty figures or damage details.

stories.title: Study finds global warming has accelerated to about 0.35°C per decade
stories.summary: A Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research study in Geophysical Research Letters reports warming of about 0.35°C per decade over the past 10 years, versus just under 0.2°C per decade from 1970 to 2015. The authors say the acceleration began around 2015 and is statistically significant at over 98 percent after adjusting for El Niño, volcanic and solar effects, across five major datasets. If the rate continues, they warn of exceeding the Paris Agreement's 1.5°C limit before 2030. The study did not determine the physical causes of the acceleration.

stories.title: Voyager 1 resumes contact after brief communications pause; power-saving swap completed
stories.summary: NASA's Deep Space Network could not detect Voyager 1's signal on October 18 and 19, and contact resumed on October 20. NASA says a group of thrusters went offline and backups activated, likely putting the spacecraft into a protective safe state; the cause is under investigation. Separately, engineers swapped three devices for lower-power alternatives in early September, which NASA says avoids shutting off another instrument as early as summer 2027. Voyager 1 is about 16 billion miles from Earth and will be one light-day away on November 18.
